verdict.rationale: Vestd has a shareholder dashboards page with an "Invite your team" pitch, and option recipients can submit exercise requests through the platform themselves, which implies a stakeholder-facing login. The evidence never describes what that portal shows. missing for 10: evidence of per-employee grant views, vesting progress tracking, strike price display, exit/outcome scenario modelling of equity value, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
